verdict.rationale: A personal AI agent could plausibly expose a public API, so this axis applies. However, every documented interface is a chat client (mobile, Mac, WhatsApp). Probes found no published OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (both behind 401) and no discovery or spec route on api.muse.ai. Muse's ability to call other services' APIs (muse-docs-14) is outbound and is not a public API for driving Muse itself.
